---
applyTo: "docs/**"
---

When editing `docs/`, follow `AGENTS.md` and `docs/brief.md`.

- `docs/workflow.md`: each step has exactly one type (deterministic / LLM judgment / human-in-the-loop) and a rationale.
- `docs/deployment.md`: systems that already exist, the integration point, and why AI does or does not belong there.
- `docs/core-loop.md`: order audit → evals → deployment; do not skip stages.
- Do not invent the business case while company/process TODOs are still open.
- All documentation in this folder is English.
